title: Signal-Informed Temporal Routing for Vinyl Defect Regime Detection
abstract: arXiv:2609.23164v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vinyl restoration systems must distinguish isolated clicks, short bursts, dense crackle, and overlapping damage before selecting a repair operation. We present a lightweight two-stage detector in which signal-informed sparse, burst, and dense experts produce complementary defect evidence, and a temporal backend converts that evidence into stable repair regimes. The backend factors the five-way decision hierarchically, applies a validation-only mixed regime gate, and decodes with validation-selected transition penalties that outperform a maximum-likelihood transition matrix on the same emissions. On a source-separated synthetic benchmark of 597 non-overlapping 15 s excerpts drawn from 21 recordings, the held-out system reaches 0.730 pooled five-class macro F1 (95% CI 0.694-0.761), an improvement of 0.043 over a flat frame-level router (paired bootstrap p=0.001). translated_abstract: 黑胶唱片修复系统在选择修复操作之前，必须区分孤立的咔哒声、短促的爆音、密集的裂纹噪声以及重叠损伤。我们提出了一种轻量级两阶段检测器，其中信号感知的稀疏、爆音和密集专家产生互补的缺陷证据，时间后端将这些证据转换为稳定的修复状态。该后端对五分类决策进行分层分解，应用仅在验证集上使用的混合状态门控，并采用验证集选择的转移惩罚进行解码，在相同的发射概率下，其性能优于最大似然转移矩阵。在一个由来自21个录音的597个不重叠15秒片段组成的源分离合成基准上，留出测试系统达到0.730的合并五分类宏F1（95%置信区间0.694-0.761），相比平坦的帧级路由器提升了0.043（配对自助法p=0.001）。干净帧和密集帧的检测高度可靠，而稀疏、爆音和混合状态（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出一种轻量级两阶段检测器，通过信号感知专家产生互补缺陷证据，并结合分层决策、混合状态门控和验证集选择的转移惩罚的时间后端来检测黑胶唱片缺陷状态，在合成基准上五分类宏F1达到0.730，显著优于帧级路由器。
en_tdlr: A lightweight two-stage detector with signal-informed experts and a temporal backend featuring hierarchical decisions, a validation-only mixed regime gate, and validation-selected transition penalties achieves 0.730 macro F1 on vinyl defect regime detection, significantly outperforming a flat frame-level router.
